title: Tampered ML: Evaluating LLM Judgment of Machine Learning Research
abstract: arXiv:2610.32114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: One approach to accelerating progress on AI alignment is to automate parts of alignment research itself. Doing so requires systems that can perform reliably on hard-to-supervise research tasks, including identifying flaws in research proposals and evaluating whether a proposed experiment supports its intended claim. To evaluate this capability, we introduce Tampered ML, a benchmark of 1,858 item-pairs, each consisting of an experiment proposal reconstructed from a published machine learning paper and a minimally edited counterfactual that introduces a targeted methodological flaw. Models must identify the more methodologically sound proposal in both presentation orders. A human validation study on a stratified sample estimates that 86% of items are valid (95% CI: 81-91%). translated_title: Tampered ML：评估大语言模型对机器学习研究的判断力
translated_abstract: 加速AI对齐研究进展的一种途径是将对齐研究本身的部分工作自动化。这要求系统能够在难以监督的研究任务上可靠运行，包括识别研究提案中的缺陷，以及评估一个提议的实验是否能支持其预期结论。为了评估这一能力，我们引入了Tampered ML，这是一个包含1,858个条目对的基准，每个条目对由一个从已发表的机器学习论文中重构的实验提案，以及一个经过最小化编辑、引入了针对性方法论缺陷的反事实版本组成。模型必须在两种呈现顺序下识别出方法论上更合理的提案。一项针对分层样本的人类验证研究估计，86%的条目是有效的（95%置信区间：81-91%）。前沿模型的表现高于随机水平，但仍远未达到可靠程度（其中Opus 5达到77.9%的准确率）。它们对呈现顺序高度敏感，并且f……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Tampered ML基准，通过将真实机器学习论文的实验提案与人为引入方法论缺陷的最小修改版本配对，来评估大语言模型识别研究方法缺陷的能力，发现前沿模型虽优于随机水平但远未达到可靠程度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Tampered ML, a benchmark of 1,858 item-pairs pairing real ML experiment proposals with minimally edited counterfactuals containing targeted methodological flaws, showing that frontier models perform above chance but remain far from reliable at judging the methodological soundness of ML research.
